name: CollectivWork
description_en:
CollectivWork is a connected business platform with separate HR, recruitment, performance, learning and project-management suites. CollectivHR supplies employee records, attendance, leave, payroll, expenses and workforce operations; purchasing one suite should not be interpreted as purchasing all five.

For an HR team, the strongest documented evaluation path joins attendance exceptions, leave approvals, logged time and field visits around the employee record. The official website contains illustrative interface data rather than evidence of customer outcomes, and the actual module mix and implementation cost require a quote.
description_zh:
CollectivWork 是包含 HR、招聘、绩效、学习及项目管理等独立套件的互联业务平台。CollectivHR 提供员工档案、考勤、休假、工资、费用及人员运营；购买一个套件不能理解为同时购买全部五个。

对 HR 团队而言，可以围绕员工档案评估考勤异常、休假审批、工时及外勤拜访的衔接。官网界面示例数据不代表客户实际结果，真实模块组合及实施费用需要报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Workforce pages describe missed-punch requests, manager review and location- or employee-group rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 人员运营页面说明漏卡申请、经理审核以及按地点或员工组设置规则。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees view balances and request leave; manager approval updates team availability.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工查看余额并申请休假，经理批准后更新团队可用情况。

core_features.explanation_en: Visit status, location context, task ownership and logged hours support distributed workforce oversight.
core_features.explanation_zh: 拜访状态、地点背景、任务负责人及工时记录支持分布式团队管理。

pricing.summary_en: Custom pricing by workforce, selected suites/modules, deployment and customization; implementation inclusions and any extra charges must be quoted.
pricing.summary_zh: 按人数、所选套件模块、部署及定制定价；实施包含项和额外费用需报价确认。

sources.title: Workforce Management Software | CollectivWork
sources.research_notes_en: Read employee/manager operations, regularization, leave, timesheets, task and visit examples; kept illustrative data distinct from observed outcomes.

sources.title: Pricing | CollectivWork

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Select a suite before selecting features
sections.en: The pricing page distinguishes CollectivHR, CollectivHire, CollectivPerform, CollectivLMS and Project Management, plus an all-suite bundle. HR includes employee records, workforce operations, leave, payroll, expenses, offboarding and self-service. Recruitment screening belongs to Hire, review cycles and OKRs to Perform, and SCORM course support to LMS. Those adjacent capabilities explain the platform’s scope but are not assumed HR entitlements. CollectivCRM is explicitly marked coming soon and is not treated as an available core feature here.
sections.zh: 价格页区分 CollectivHR、CollectivHire、CollectivPerform、CollectivLMS、Project Management 及全套组合。HR 涵盖员工档案、人员运营、休假、工资、费用、离职和自助；招聘筛选属于 Hire，评审周期和 OKR 属于 Perform，SCORM 课程属于 LMS。这些相邻能力说明平台范围，不代表 HR 采购自动包含。CollectivCRM 明确标注即将推出，本档案不把它视为已可用核心功能。

sections.title_en: Evaluate an exception from submission to review
sections.title_zh: 评估从提交到审核的异常流程
sections.en: The Workforce Management page illustrates a missing punch submitted by an employee, reviewed against a biometric log and approved by a manager. It also describes attendance regularization as a capability and rules by location, entity, employee group or work pattern. A useful pilot would reproduce one missed punch under a real policy and check the payroll consequence. The website’s named staff, counts, dates and approved-payroll example are interface illustrations, not a completed transaction or measured result. Hardware compatibility and exact recalculation behavior still require testing.
sections.zh: 人员运营页面展示员工提交漏卡、经理对照生物识别日志审核并批准的示例，也明确描述考勤补正，以及按地点、实体、员工组或工作模式设置规则。试运行可以按真实政策重现一次漏卡，再检查对工资的影响。官网示例中的姓名、数量、日期和工资更新均为界面演示，不能作为已完成交易或实测结果；硬件兼容性及重新计算的具体行为仍需测试。

sections.title_en: Keep leave, capacity and field visits in context
sections.title_zh: 结合休假、产能与外勤背景
sections.en: Employees can see leave balances, submit requests and record hours against work; managers can review requests, team availability and utilization. Field functionality describes assigned locations, visit progress and location-aware context, while tasks have owners and statuses. For example, a planned client visit that coincides with approved leave should be checked in both the availability view and the task process. That is suggested evaluation guidance, not a documented automatic rescheduling rule. Decide what location data is collected and who may see it before enabling field tracking; mobile and device behavior was not exercised.
sections.zh: 员工可查看休假余额、提交申请并按工作记录时间；经理可审核申请、查看团队可用情况及利用率。外勤功能描述指定地点、拜访进度和位置背景，任务则有负责人及状态。例如计划客户拜访与已批准休假重合时，应同时检查可用人员视图和任务流程。这是评估建议，不是官方已承诺的自动改期规则。启用外勤跟踪前需明确采集哪些位置数据、谁可访问；本研究未测试移动端及设备行为。

sections.title_en: The quote determines more than employee count
sections.title_zh: 报价不只取决于员工数
sections.en: No numeric rate is published in the reviewed pricing page. The FAQ says price depends on employee count, modules, deployment model and customization. It says standard configuration may be included, while extensive development and onboarding charges vary by scope. A platform-essentials section lists guided implementation and cloud hosting, but the FAQ makes the exact configuration, migration, training and support inclusions subject to quotation. Obtain those deliverables in writing. A free trial is advertised without a verified duration or a sustained free plan. The cloud-hosted description does not independently establish which alternative deployment models are sold.
sections.zh: 所读价格页未公开数值费率。FAQ 表示价格取决于人数、模块、部署模式和定制，标准配置可能包含，较深开发及入门费用按范围变化。平台基础能力一节列出引导实施和云托管，但 FAQ 将配置、迁移、培训及支持的具体包含项交由报价确定，应书面列明。页面提供免费试用，但未核实期限或长期免费套餐。云托管描述也不能独立证明还销售哪些替代部署方式。

sections.title_en: Pilot the rule combinations that matter
sections.en: CollectivWork merits evaluation for teams combining HR with multi-location or field operations and potentially adding other suites later. A buyer needing only a small employee directory should weigh configuration and procurement effort. Prepare employee identities, leave balances, shifts, policy groups and approvers; then test a rejected request, missed punch and overdue field visit. Security, encryption and audit logs are vendor-listed platform essentials, not independently inspected controls. Regional payroll filings, integration failure handling, complete exports, retention, hosting jurisdiction and source-code licensing remain unverified.
sections.zh: 需要把 HR 与多地点或外勤运营结合，并可能逐步增加其他套件的团队，可以评估 CollectivWork。仅需小型员工通讯录的买家应衡量配置及采购投入。需准备员工身份、休假余额、班次、政策组及审批人，再测试拒批申请、漏卡和逾期拜访。安全、加密及审计日志属于供应商列出的基础能力，未经独立检查。地区工资申报、集成失败处理、完整导出、保留期限、托管辖区及源代码许可仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No trial, device, payroll, field-location or integration workflow was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行试用、设备、工资、外勤定位或集成流程。

research_gaps.en: Trial duration, exact module price, hosting jurisdiction, exports and regional payroll coverage were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实试用期限、具体模块价格、托管辖区、导出及地区工资覆盖。
